_comment: HUMAN-OWNED CONFIG (ADR 0006). Per the observe-and-report governance decision, the AI must not set the thresholds or repo list that decide how heavily AI-authored work is verified. This file is the human's dial: the reconciler only READS it. Reviewers: this is the load-bearing artifact — scrutinise the rework_rate_warn floors and the repo list.

rework_rate_warn._comment: Warn (propose, never enforce) when a bucket's rework_rate exceeds its floor AND sample_size >= min_sample. Sensitive categories get tighter floors.

circuit_breaker._comment: ADR 0007 params — consumed by a future escalation pass, recorded here so the dial lives in one human-owned place. Not yet acted on by the MVP.

repos_comment: Refreshed 2026-08-21 per ADR 0113: top 10 org repos by 6-week bot-filtered commit-activity, excluding verjson-agents (tooling, not a shipped product). See the ADR for methodology and the ranked list.
